name: Earnings Beat vs Miss: 30-Day Forward Returns
description: Compares 30-day forward returns after earnings beats (EPS surprise > 0) vs misses (EPS surprise <= 0) for AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, and GOOGL. Includes per-asset boxplots grouped by beat/miss, cross-sectional summary table with avg/median returns and hit rates, and event markers on each earnings date.
source:
# --- Earnings Beat vs Miss: 30-Day Forward Returns ---
# Per-asset study: AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL
# Beat = eps_surprise_percent > 0, Miss = eps_surprise_percent <= 0
# Forward 30-day simple return from earnings date close

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()
earn = earnings()
ts = index().value

# --- Earnings event detection ---
had_earnings = is_valid(earn.actual_eps) and is_valid(earn.eps_surprise_percent)

# --- Classification ---
is_beat = had_earnings and earn.eps_surprise_percent > 0
is_miss = had_earnings and earn.eps_surprise_percent <= 0

# Beat/Miss label for boxplot grouping
beat_miss_label = conditional_select(is_beat, "Beat", is_miss, "Miss", "None")

# --- Forward returns (30 trading days) ---
fwd_30d = forward_returns(src.c, 30)

# --- Filtered returns for boxplot (only on earnings bars) ---
earnings_fwd_30d = where(had_earnings, fwd_30d)

# --- Beat/Miss filtered returns for table ---
beat_fwd_30d = where(is_beat, fwd_30d)
miss_fwd_30d = where(is_miss, fwd_30d)

# --- Hit rate: % of beats with positive forward return (S29 pattern) ---
beat_hit = 1.0 if (is_beat and fwd_30d > 0) else 0.0
beat_hit_filtered = where(is_beat, beat_hit)

# --- Boxplot: per-asset, grouped by Beat vs Miss ---
# Earnings label for grouping (string on earnings bars only)
earnings_label = where(had_earnings, beat_miss_label)

boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title="30-Day Forward Returns After Earnings",
    x_axis_label="Outcome",
    y_axis_label="30-Day Forward Return",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    outlier_color=Color.Orange,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    category="Earnings Analysis",
    order=0
)(values=earnings_fwd_30d, label=earnings_label)

# --- Cross-sectional summary table ---
cs_summary_table(
    title="Earnings Beat vs Miss Summary",
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title="Earnings Beat vs Miss Summary",
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg 30d Ret (Beat)", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg 30d Ret (Miss)", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title="Median Beat", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median),
            ColumnSpec(title="Median Miss", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median),
            ColumnSpec(title="Hit Rate (Beat)", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title="# Beat Events", type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count),
            ColumnSpec(title="# Miss Events", type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count)
        ]
    ),
    category="Earnings Analysis",
    order=1
)((beat_fwd_30d, miss_fwd_30d, beat_fwd_30d, miss_fwd_30d, beat_hit_filtered, beat_fwd_30d, miss_fwd_30d))

# --- Event markers: Earnings Beat ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Earnings Beat",
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Outcome", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title="EPS Surprise %", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="Actual EPS", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title="Estimated EPS", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title="30d Fwd Return", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(("Beat", earn.eps_surprise_percent, earn.actual_eps, earn.estimated_eps, fwd_30d, is_beat))

# --- Event markers: Earnings Miss ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Earnings Miss",
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Outcome", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title="EPS Surprise %", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="Actual EPS", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title="Estimated EPS", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title="30d Fwd Return", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(("Miss", earn.eps_surprise_percent, earn.actual_eps, earn.estimated_eps, fwd_30d, is_miss))
